title: Require production graphs to compose registered recipes only
narrative: Production graphs should be composed from registered recipes (including nested recipes), not free-form node synthesis. Tiling and recipe-as-tool already help (`fangore_recipe_namespace_tile`, `fangore_recipe_as_tool`). Tracks MH-SR-02[^insp-sr-02].
implementation: GraphTemplateRegistry, tile/nest, embed_recipe_as_tool. Desired: hard production constraint that graphs are registry-recipe compositions only.
validation: Kind `inspiration_delta_contract`. Soft expects requirement_id MH-SR-02, coverage partial, adjacent_ok, probes_ok with typed surface probes encoding the current product delta.
